reference_items.subject: Mathematics
reference_items.stem:
[Image: Rectangle ABCD containing two tangent circles P and Q]

In the figure above, ABCD is a rectangle, and circles P and Q each have a radius of 5 cm. What is the area of the rectangle?
reference_items.figure_description: A rectangle ABCD is oriented horizontally with vertices labeled A at the top-left, B at the top-right, C at the bottom-right, and D at the bottom-left. Inside the rectangle are two identical circles labeled P and Q, with their centers marked by dots labeled P and Q. The two circles are tangent to each other horizontally at the midline of the rectangle. Circle P touches the left side AD, the top side AB, and the bottom side CD. Circle Q touches circle P, the right side BC, the top side AB, and the bottom side CD. A vertical line segment is drawn from center P up to the point of tangency on top side AB, labeled "5 cm".
reference_items.calibration: Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 1999 and 2003 eighth-grade mathematics data.

slope.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the two-parameter logistic (2PL) model, which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 1 point, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 1999 and 2003 eighth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's slope (discrimination) parameter a? A higher a means that the item separates students of lower and higher mathematics ability more sharply. Choose the value closest to it. The state also lists reference items: the calibrated TIMSS items of the same grade most similar to this one (never the item itself or its other parts), most similar first, with their percent correct and their calibrated parameters, each on the scale of its own calibration. Use them to place this item.

location.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the two-parameter logistic (2PL) model, which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 1 point, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 1999 and 2003 eighth-grade mathematics data". The state also lists reference items: the calibrated TIMSS items of the same grade most similar to this one (never the item itself or its other parts), most similar first, with their percent correct and their calibrated parameters, each on the scale of its own calibration.
